SELECT
    pc.ProductCategoryName,
    sumIf(f.SalesAmount, f.PromotionKey = 1)                                                  AS full_price_revenue,
    sumIf(f.SalesAmount, f.PromotionKey != 1)                                                 AS promo_revenue,
    sumIf(f.SalesAmount, f.PromotionKey != 1) - sumIf(f.SalesAmount, f.PromotionKey = 1)     AS incremental_revenue,
    round(
        sumIf(f.SalesAmount, f.PromotionKey != 1) * 100.0
        / nullif(sumIf(f.SalesAmount, f.PromotionKey = 1), 0),
    2)                                                                                         AS promo_vs_fullprice_pct,
    round(
        sumIf(f.SalesAmount, f.PromotionKey != 1) * 100.0
        / nullif(sum(f.SalesAmount), 0),
    2)                                                                                         AS promo_share_of_total_pct
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f
JOIN retail.DimProduct p
    ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory ps
    ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = ps.ProductSubcategoryKey
JOIN retail.DimProductCategory pc
    ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
GROUP BY pc.ProductCategoryName
ORDER BY incremental_revenue DESC
